name: AM2301 (DHT21) wired temperature & humidity sensor
description: Aosong/ASAIR AM2301 (also sold as DHT21) calibrated temperature (-40 to 80 °C, ±0.5 °C) and relative humidity (0–99.9 %RH, ±3 %RH) sensor in a black housing with a single-wire digital output, 0.1 °C / 0.1 %RH resolution, read at most every 2 s. Runs on 3.3–5.5 V (5 V recommended); the data wire needs a 5.1 kΩ pull-up. Uses the same 40-bit data format as the DHT22/AM2302. Sold as: Aosong AM2301 / DHT21 wired sensor with a 3-wire lead (red VDD, yellow SDA = data, black GND).
eli5: A small black box on a cable that tells your board how warm and how damp the air is, to a tenth of a degree, over one wire. It needs one resistor to help it talk.

pins.name: VDD
pins.description: Red wire (pin 1): supply, 3.3–5.5 V DC (5 V recommended)

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: Yellow wire (pin 2): single-wire bidirectional data (Aosong one-wire protocol, NOT I2C); needs a 5.1 kΩ pull-up to VDD

supplierQuery: AM2301 DHT21 temperature humidity sensor wired
buildNotes: Wire colours (Aosong datasheet table 4): red = VDD, yellow = SDA (data), black = GND. The yellow 'SDA' wire is the single-wire DHT data line, not I2C: connect it to any GPIO that can output as well as input (not GPIO 34-39 on an ESP32), not to the board's I2C SDA pin specifically.
Fit a 5.1 kΩ pull-up from the yellow data wire to VDD (datasheet: 1–100 kΩ allowed, 5.1 kΩ recommended for leads under 30 m).
5 V is the recommended supply. On 3.3 V keep the total lead under 1 m, or the voltage drop makes readings wrong.

Use MicroPython's built-in dht module with the DHT22 class: dht.DHT22(Pin(n)). The AM2301 sends the same 40 bits (humidity x10, temperature x10 with bit 15 as the minus sign, then an 8-bit sum checksum), so DHT22 decoding is correct; a bad checksum or no answer raises OSError.
Wait at least 2 s after power-up before the first read, then read no more often than every 2 s. Each read returns the previous measurement, so after a long pause read twice and use the second value.
Normal operating range is 0-80 %RH; long exposure above 80 %RH causes a temporary drift.

example.code:
from machine import Pin
import dht, time

# AM2301 / DHT21 uses the same data format as the DHT22
sensor = dht.DHT22(Pin({SDA}))
time.sleep(2)  # AM2301: wait at least 2 s after power-up
while True:
    try:
        sensor.measure()
        print('T=%.1fC H=%.1f%%' % (sensor.temperature(), sensor.humidity()))
    except OSError as e:
        print('AM2301 read failed:', e)
    time.sleep(2)  # AM2301: at most one reading every 2 s

test.title: Reports the temperature (including below zero) and humidity set on the sliders
